name: unsplash
description: Unsplash stock-photo picker for the Celestia CMS media dialog: server-side proxy route keeps the access key private, writers search/browse and insert photos with attribution
notes: Requires the cms feature (run `pnpm add-feature cms` first). Add UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY to the Celestia app's .env (create an app at https://unsplash.com/developers) and restart the dev server. The media dialog is shared with media-r2/cms — this feature's copy (with the Unsplash tab) wins on install; remove-feature restores nothing, so re-add `pnpm add-feature media-r2` afterwards if you need its variant. No DB changes, no new dependencies (native fetch only).
